samplingCeiling: Eight fresh CPU pairs per cohort/workload in ONE Node process, sharing compiled modules per artifact. Distinct CPU identities do not establish statistical independence across process/JIT/OS/time effects. Five later paired samples per fresh pair; headline aggregates pair-level medians, not forty statistically independent observations.
placementCeiling: Linear-memory pointer geometry only; every observed pointer is1114624/mod64=0. No measured pointer-placement variation or exact physical/native mechanism is established.
timingCeiling: No wall metric or per-sample TimeState check is added. Cpu.creationMs includes instantiate-observer promise bookkeeping; pointer/descriptor reads occur after the factory timer.
historicalFieldMeaning: The raw summaries field independentCpuPairs counts separately created CPU identities. It is not a claim of statistical independence or eight independent Node processes.
conclusion: The creation-order-balanced fresh-pair calibration does not reproduce a stable artifact-linked x87 slowdown. Earlier shifts remain historical observations; no zero-overhead, MMX speedup or exact placement mechanism is claimed.
